description: Weekly minor and patch updates, merged once the CI passes; majors, ory/hydra-client-go and BuildKit in pull requests of their own, reviewed.

packageRules.description: Minor and patch updates and new digests, grouped each week, merged once the CI passes (tests, govulncheck).
The Go toolchain of go.mod and the golang image of the Dockerfile move together: the image sets GOTOOLCHAIN=local.
A major version: a pull request of its own, reviewed.
ory/hydra-client-go follows the version of Hydra the dispatcher is played against: a pull request of its own, reviewed.
BuildKit of the workflows, pinned by digest: reviewed.

The standalone Tailwind CLI of examples/theme-demo/build.sh: its four checksums come by hand from the release's sha256sums.txt, then theme.css is built again and committed; the CI fails until both are done.

Scalar's API reference of web/scalar/fetch.sh, the page of /admin/v1/docs: its integrity and its sha256 by hand, standalone.js fetched again and committed, the page read in a browser (the Issues panel for a violation of its CSP, no button of Scalar's services: web/scalar/README.md); the CI fails until the file is there.

Pico CSS of web/pico/fetch.sh, the sheet of the admin UI: its integrity and its sha256 by hand, the sheet fetched again and committed, the admin UI read in a browser for a violation of its CSP (web/pico/README.md); the CI fails until the file is there.

cosign of the release workflow and Trivy of the test workflow: their two checksums come by hand from the release's checksums file (Trivy's verified by its Sigstore bundle); the workflow stops on a wrong one: reviewed.
